title: prewarm.php response
description: Status of the morning pre-warm sweep: whether it is enabled on this site and what the most recent run did. Counts only; no patient references. No authentication, like health.php and ready.php. Alert when enabled is true and no run with today's target_date exists by 06:30 on a clinic day, or when errored > 0.

enabled.description: COPILOT_PREWARM_ENABLED on this site. A --force run can leave a last_run while this is false.

last_run.description: The most recent run, or null when none has ever run.

target_date.description: The clinic day the run warmed.

finished_at.description: When the last receipt of the run was written (ISO 8601, site zone).
